Privacy.metadataDescription: JobDone AI privacy policy for the public website and closed-preview access requests.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how JobDone AI handles personal data for this public website, closed-preview access requests, contact messages, and related communications.

responsible.title: 1. Who is responsible
paragraphs: JobDone AI, Zurich, Switzerland is responsible for the processing described in this Privacy Policy unless a separate agreement says otherwise.
For privacy requests, access requests, deletion requests, or questions about this policy, contact us through the <contact>JobDone AI contact form</contact>.

collect.title: 3. Data we collect
collect.paragraph: We collect only what is reasonably needed to operate the website, respond to inquiries, evaluate access requests, and keep the service secure.
items: Contact data, such as your name, email address, company, role, topic, and message content.
Website data, such as pages visited, approximate location from IP address, device and browser information, referrer information, and basic logs used for security and reliability.
Preview discussion data, such as workflow descriptions, business context, requested integrations, and notes you choose to share with us.
Diagnostic and security data, such as server logs, error reports, abuse-prevention signals, and operational metadata.

payments.title: 4. Payment data
paragraphs: The public website does not currently process payments or public subscriptions.
If commercial access is arranged separately, payment and contracting information may be handled under separate terms or by third-party providers.

use.title: 5. How we use data
use.paragraph: We use personal data for these purposes:
items: To operate, secure, maintain, and improve the public website.
To respond to contact messages and closed-preview access requests.
To evaluate whether JobDone AI is a fit for a requested workflow, pilot, or partnership discussion.
To monitor reliability, diagnose issues, prevent abuse, and protect the website and service.
To comply with legal obligations, enforce terms, and defend our rights where necessary.

bases.title: 6. Legal bases
paragraphs: Where the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection, the GDPR, or similar laws apply, we rely on appropriate legal bases, including your request, our legitimate interests in operating and protecting the website, consent where required, legal obligations, and establishing or defending legal claims.
You may withdraw consent where processing is based on consent, but that does not affect processing that happened before withdrawal or processing that is allowed on another legal basis.

thirdParties.title: 7. Third-party services
thirdParties.paragraph: We may use service providers to host, secure, monitor, analyze, and operate the website and communications.
items: Hosting, infrastructure, database, storage, and security providers.
Analytics or diagnostics providers used to understand reliability and website usage.
Email, CRM, support, workflow, or issue-tracking tools used to respond to access requests and messages.
Professional advisers, legal providers, and compliance service providers where needed.
thirdParties.after: We do not sell personal data.

sharing.title: 8. Sharing and disclosures
paragraphs: We may share personal data with service providers, professional advisers, authorities, courts, regulators, or other parties when needed to operate the website, comply with law, protect rights and safety, investigate misuse, or complete a business transfer such as a merger, acquisition, financing, or asset sale.
We do not make closed-preview inquiry details public.

retention.title: 9. Retention
paragraphs: We keep personal data only as long as reasonably needed for the purposes described in this policy, including responding to inquiries, maintaining business records, security, audit, legal compliance, and defending legal claims.

If you request deletion, we will delete or anonymize personal data where required and reasonably possible. Some information may remain in backups, logs, legal records, or security records for a limited period where retention is required or permitted by law.

rights.title: 10. Your rights and choices
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, receive a copy of, restrict, object to, or withdraw consent for certain processing of your personal data. You may also have a right to complain to a data protection authority.
You can send privacy, export, correction, and deletion requests through the <contact>JobDone AI contact form</contact>. We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request.

security.title: 11. Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect personal data. No website, cloud service, device, or internet transmission can be guaranteed to be fully secure, error-free, or lossless.

transfers.title: 12. International transfers
paragraphs: JobDone AI is based in Switzerland. Our providers and infrastructure may be located in Switzerland, the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, the United States, or other countries. Where required, we use appropriate transfer safeguards such as contractual protections, adequacy decisions, or other lawful transfer mechanisms.

children.title: 13. Children and age
paragraphs: The JobDone AI public website and preview process are not directed to children under 16.

changes.title: 14. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy when our service, data practices, providers, or legal requirements change. The updated version will be posted on this page with a new last-updated date.

preview.title: 2. Closed-preview scope
paragraphs: JobDone AI is currently in closed preview and is not generally available as a public self-serve service.
This policy covers the public website and preview-related communications. Any pilot or customer deployment may be governed by separate written agreements, security terms, and data-processing terms.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of the JobDone AI public website, contact forms, closed-preview access requests, and related communications.

paragraphs: The public website is provided by JobDone AI, Zurich, Switzerland ("JobDone AI", "we", "us", or "our").
Questions about these terms, privacy requests, deletion requests, or access requests can be sent through the <contact>JobDone AI contact form</contact>.

acceptance.title: 2. Acceptance of these terms
paragraphs: By accessing or using this website, contact form, preview request flow, or related feature, you agree to these Terms of Service and the <privacy>JobDone AI Privacy Policy</privacy>.
If you use the website on behalf of an organization, you confirm that you have authority to act for that organization.

eligibility.title: 4. Eligibility
paragraphs: You must be at least 16 years old and legally able to accept these terms to use the website or submit a request.

responsibilities.title: 5. Your responsibilities
responsibilities.paragraph: You are responsible for how you use the website, including:
items: Using the website only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these terms.
Providing accurate information in contact and access-request forms.
Making sure you have the right to share any company, workflow, document, system, or personal data you provide.
Reviewing any information we provide before relying on it for business decisions.
Keeping confidential information out of public or non-secure messages unless separately agreed.

prohibited.title: 6. Prohibited use
items: Use the website in a way that is unlawful, harmful, deceptive, abusive, harassing, defamatory, invasive of privacy, or infringing.
Upload or send content that you do not have permission to use or that violates another person or organization's rights.
Interfere with, disrupt, reverse engineer, scrape, overload, probe, or bypass the security of the website except where allowed by law.
Use the website to transmit malware, spam, fraudulent messages, or unauthorized advertising.
Misrepresent your identity, organization, authority, or relationship to JobDone AI.

content.title: 7. Information you submit
paragraphs: You keep ownership of information you submit through the website. You grant JobDone AI the limited rights needed to receive, process, review, respond to, and store that information for the purposes described in these terms and our Privacy Policy.
You are solely responsible for the information you submit and for ensuring you have permission to share it.

purchases.title: 10. Commercial terms
paragraphs: The public website does not currently offer self-serve purchases.
Any commercial access, pilot, paid deployment, data-processing arrangement, or service-level commitment must be agreed separately in writing.

availability.title: 11. Changes, availability, and updates
paragraphs: We may modify, suspend, discontinue, limit, rename, remove, or update the website or any preview-related feature at any time.

warranties.title: 12. No warranties
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the website and preview materials are provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, whether express, implied, statutory, or otherwise.

JobDone AI does not warrant that the website will be uninterrupted, timely, secure, private, error-free, lossless, accurate, complete, compatible with every device or platform, or fit for any particular purpose.

liability.title: 13. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by law, JobDone AI will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, exemplary, punitive, reliance, business-interruption, lost-profit, lost-data, lost-goodwill, device, network, or third-party damages, even if JobDone AI has been advised that such damages may occur.

Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability where it would be unlawful to do so, including liability for unlawful intent or gross negligence where such liability cannot be excluded under mandatory Swiss law.

indemnity.title: 14. Indemnity
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by law, you agree to indemnify and hold JobDone AI harmless from claims, losses, liabilities, damages, costs, and expenses arising from information you submit, your use or misuse of the website, your violation of these terms, your violation of law, or your violation of another person or organization's rights.

termination.title: 15. Termination
paragraphs: You may stop using the website at any time. We may suspend, restrict, or block access to the website if we reasonably believe you violated these terms, created risk, caused harm, used the website unlawfully, or if the website or a feature is discontinued.

Sections that by their nature should survive termination will survive, including ownership, user responsibility, disclaimers, limitation of liability, indemnity, governing law, and dispute provisions.

law.title: 17. Governing law and venue
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of Switzerland, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. The courts of Zurich, Switzerland have exclusive jurisdiction, except where mandatory law gives you the right to bring claims elsewhere.

changes.title: 18. Changes to these terms

Continued use of the website after updated terms become effective means you accept the updated terms.

preview.title: 3. Closed preview
paragraphs: JobDone AI is currently in closed preview and is not generally available as a public self-serve service.

Submitting a request does not guarantee access, a pilot, a partnership, feature availability, pricing, timing, or any commercial relationship. Any pilot or deployment may require separate written agreements.

websiteInfo.title: 8. Website information
paragraphs: Website copy, diagrams, mockups, product descriptions, and preview materials are provided for general informational purposes.
Because JobDone AI is in closed preview, features, positioning, availability, pricing, integrations, and product details may change.

aiOutputs.title: 9. AI outputs and workflow discussions

You are responsible for evaluating whether any workflow, automation, AI output, integration, or record update is appropriate for your organization and legal obligations.
